    ans = INF

    for low in vals:
        candidates = []

        i = 0
        while i < N:
            if A[i] < low:
                i += 1
                continue

            j = i
            while j < N and A[j] >= low:
                j += 1

            # Segment A[i:j] where all elements >= low
            seg = sorted(A[i:j])
            m = len(seg)
            # From a segment of length m, we can perform at most m-K+1 operations.
            # The possible removed minima are the smallest m-K+1 elements in this segment.
            take = m - K + 1
            if take > 0:
                candidates.extend(seg[:take])

            i = j

        if len(candidates) < Q:
            continue

        candidates.sort()
        ans = min(ans, candidates[Q - 1] - low)

    print(ans)
